t: You're looking at Draped Woman, a sculpture by Karel Vogel. Vogel was a Czech-born English sculptor who lived from 1897 to 1961, and he made this work. I don't have much more information about the piece itself, so I'll say less rather than guess. Take a moment to walk around it and look at how the drapery is carved, since that's the feature the title points to, and see how the figure sits within the space around it.
